units: <cite ref="Pesachim 3b:6">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>בּוֹצְרִין בטהרה</he> one must cut grapes under the rules of levitical cleanness.
<cite ref="Gittin 57a:23">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>בָּצְרוּ … את כרמיהן וכ׳</he> the gentiles held vintage in vineyards soaked with Israel’s blood; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite>, beg. <he>עד שתגיע עונתן לִיבָּצֵר</he> until their (the nations’) time has arrived to be cut (ripe for punishment).

senses.gloss: to be cut off, diminished. Tanḥ. Noah 18 נִבְצָרִים מן וכ׳ cut off from the world (destroyed).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:9">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>יִבָּצֵר מהם</he> shall be denied them.

senses.gloss: to surround, fortify. Part. pass. מְבוּצָּר. Y. Pes. VII, 35ᵇ bot.; Y. Shebu. VIII, beg., 38ᵇ גג מב׳ a roof surrounded with railings, v. בְּצוֹצְרָה.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:5">Neg. I, 5</cite> <he>מְבוּצֶּרֶת</he> an eruption surrounded with sound flesh; <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 10:2">ib. X, 2</cite> sq. <he>מבוצר</he> (of the hair in the flesh affected by the eruption).

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <he>עיר מצור</he> <cite ref="Psalms 60:11">Ps. LX, 11</cite>, a. <he>מבצר</he> <cite ref="Psalms 108:11">ib. CVIII, 11</cite>) <he>עיר שמבוצרת וכ׳</he> the city (of Rome) which is well fortified &c.

senses.gloss: to diminish. Ib. שמצירה ומבצרה לישראל (Mat. K. ומְבַצֶּרֶת, Yalk. Ps. 779 מבצרא ch.) the city which troubles and diminishes Israel.
to be railed around, be set apart.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 14a">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>מקום נ׳ להם וכ׳</he> a place was set apart for them in Gehenna; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:2">Koh. R. to VII, 2</cite>.
